free_running_alternative.verdict: REJECTED: independent crystals slide the windows into overlap within seconds

interference_modes.SCHEDULED: no direct mutual interference; configured leakage/background only
interference_modes.VIOLATED_SCHEDULE: victim chirps overlapping the aggressor active window receive a noise-floor rise delta_dB = 10*log10(1 + overlap_fraction * 10^(INR_dB/10)); equal-slope overlap may add a ghost; INR_dB default 25 (NEEDS_REAL_DATA_CALIBRATION)

source_time_semantics: each radar's scan source time = its own frame start (trigger edge + configured delay) on the vehicle clock; scan_sequence independent per radar; emitted at frame end + processing latency (simulated latency 0)

trigger.mechanism: HARDWARE: Radar U free-runs (frameCfg triggerSelect 1); Radar F frameCfg triggerSelect 2 (SYNC_IN) with frame trigger delay 5.101 ms from the shared trigger edge; U SYNC_OUT or an external 30 Hz pulse drives both SYNC_IN lines
trigger.pin_availability: SYNC_IN/SYNC_OUT are silicon pins (SWRS237C); exposure on the IWR6843AOPEVM header must be confirmed
